title: Meerkats Capability Registry v1 — declarative tool catalog + operation bindings
description: The action inventory (architecture Concern 3). Declarative, not imperative: each tool names a real platform API call, whether it mutates, whether and how it rolls back, and which read verifies it. The agent NEVER consumes this registry — operation_bindings is consulted by the server-side BINDER, which resolves (platform, entity, operation) into an exact tool chain at config-creation/plan time. An operation with no binding on a platform fails closed at creation (e.g. every campaign.* on flipkart — no public ads API). Mutating tools execute only inside an approved execution_plan (query_and_act/v1) or approved workflow_run (workflows_and_automations/v1), always with an idempotency key, always followed by their verify read.

registry.$comment: underscore-prefixed keys (_doc, _source) are format-mirror metadata (ci/mirror.py) — permitted, ignored

operation_bindings.description: platform -> '<entity>.<operation>' -> ordered tool chain (tool_ids). The binder's lookup table; reads may precede a mutation (e.g. increase_budget = read current -> compute -> set).

provider.description: adapter key, e.g. amazon_ads, meta_graph, google_ads, flipkart_seller, shopify_admin, slack, email_adapter

api_version.description: PINNED. Google ships monthly with ~1yr sunsets — track sunset dates per pin.

doc.description: official documentation URL the definition was verified against

params.description: human-readable payload sketch; the adapter owns the exact serialization

mutating.description: true => approval + idempotency_key + verify are all mandatory at execution

idempotent.description: true when re-sending the same payload is a no-op (absolute state sets are; relative adjustments are NOT)

rollback_tool.description: tool_id that undoes this call, replaying the captured before-value

verify.description: the read-back that confirms the mutation landed (Act -> Observe -> Verify). Verify failure triggers rollback if reversible, else escalation.

assert.description: the condition checked against the read-back

delivery.description: notification tools only: retry count and fallback channel

fallback.description: tool_id tried when this channel fails; null = terminal

allOf.description: a mutating tool must declare reversibility and its verify read
